From f5f9e07060519e2287e99019a6de1eb3ebb65c37 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dmitry Torokhov <dmitry.torokhov@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 21:13:43 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] Input: edt-ft5x06 - fix use-after-free in debugfs teardown

The commit 68743c500c6e ("Input: edt-ft5x06 - use per-client debugfs
directory") removed the manual debugfs teardown, relying on the I2C core
to handle it. However, this creates a window where debugfs files are
still accessible after edt_ft5x06_ts_teardown_debugfs() frees
tsdata->raw_buffer.

To prevent a use-after-free, protect the freeing of raw_buffer with the
device mutex and set raw_buffer to NULL. The debugfs read function
already checks if raw_buffer is NULL under the same mutex, so this
safely avoids the use-after-free.

Fixes: 68743c500c6e ("Input: edt-ft5x06 - use per-client debugfs directory")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/adnJicDh-bTUaWXP@google.com
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Torokhov <dmitry.torokhov@gmail.com>

diff --git a/drivers/input/touchscreen/edt-ft5x06.c b/drivers/input/touchscreen/edt-ft5x06.c
index ba8ff65f7ea6..d3b1177185a3 100644
--- a/drivers/input/touchscreen/edt-ft5x06.c
+++ b/drivers/input/touchscreen/edt-ft5x06.c
@@ -804,7 +804,10 @@ static void edt_ft5x06_ts_prepare_debugfs(struct edt_ft5x06_ts_data *tsdata)
 
 static void edt_ft5x06_ts_teardown_debugfs(struct edt_ft5x06_ts_data *tsdata)
 {
+	guard(mutex)(&tsdata->mutex);
+
 	kfree(tsdata->raw_buffer);
+	tsdata->raw_buffer = NULL;
 }
 
 #else
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary

The patch modifies a single file, `drivers/input/touchscreen/edt-ft5x06.c`, to fix a use-after-free vulnerability in the debugfs teardown path.

### Modifications in the file

- **`edt_ft5x06_ts_teardown_debugfs()`**: Added a `guard(mutex)(&tsdata->mutex)` to serialize the freeing of `tsdata->raw_buffer`. Immediately after `kfree(tsdata->raw_buffer)`, the pointer is set to `NULL`.

### Rationale and relationships

The bug originated from commit `68743c500c6e`, which removed manual debugfs directory teardown in favor of relying on I2C core cleanup. This left a window where debugfs files could still be read after `raw_buffer` was freed, causing a use-after-free. The existing debugfs read function (`edt_ft5x06_debugfs_read`) already checks for `NULL` under the same mutex, so by holding the mutex and nullifying the pointer, the patch safely eliminates the race condition. The guard ensures mutual exclusion, and the NULL assignment ensures that any concurrent read will see an empty buffer rather than accessing freed memory.

Input: edt-ft5x06 - fix use-after-free in debugfs teardown

The commit 68743c500c6e ("Input: edt-ft5x06 - use per-client debugfs
directory") removed the manual debugfs teardown, relying on the I2C core
to handle it. However, this creates a window where debugfs files are
still accessible after edt_ft5x06_ts_teardown_debugfs() frees
tsdata->raw_buffer.

To prevent a use-after-free, protect the freeing of raw_buffer with the
device mutex and set raw_buffer to NULL. The debugfs read function
already checks if raw_buffer is NULL under the same mutex, so this
safely avoids the use-after-free.

Fixes: 68743c500c6e ("Input: edt-ft5x06 - use per-client debugfs directory")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/adnJicDh-bTUaWXP@google.com
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Torokhov <dmitry.torokhov@gmail.com>

Here is the root cause:
The commit 68743c500c6e removed manual debugfs removal, relying on I2C core cleanup. This left a window where debugfs read operations could access tsdata->raw_buffer after it had been freed in `edt_ft5x06_ts_teardown_debugfs()`, causing a use-after-free. The teardown lacked proper synchronization (mutex) and did not set raw_buffer to NULL, so concurrent reads could still access the freed memory.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void edt_ft5x06_ts_teardown_debugfs(struct edt_ft5x06_ts_data *tsdata)
 {
+	guard(mutex)(&tsdata->mutex);
+
 	kfree(tsdata->raw_buffer);
+	tsdata->raw_buffer = NULL;
 }
